acceptance: #3911 merged; the next release-canary run on an ancestor of the release head is green and issue #3893 closes. Record whether the 50 GiB floor should be lowered or the tests made runnable on developer machines.
description: Issue #3893 (canary run 41209235137 on 8a2054135): test_large_scale_generation_uses_manifest_tracked_flight_shards (the BTS prefetcher started in _prefetching_months and hit the network guard) and test_compat_lint_passes (unregistered dialect branch _manifest_text_type from #3851). Fix PR #3911 (head f72248cb73, unmerged at filing) makes the prefetcher lazy and registers the branch with compat_local. Neither resource-heavy test could run locally: the heavy-test harness requires 50 GiB free disk (BENCHBOX_HEAVY_MIN_FREE_DISK_GIB) and the dev machine had 26.3 GiB, so the fix is verified only by unit tests and scripts/compat_lint.py. A red canary blocks every release PR in release_readiness_check.py.
